full_judgment: 11. Ext. 4(a) is certified copy of an order dated 8.9.77 passed by the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev), Dinajpur, in case No. 71/27 of 1976-77 under rule 23(4) of the Tenancy Rules made under section 152 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 1950. The present plaintiff was opposite party in this proceeding and he filed his pattani papers including dakhilas alleged to have been granted by the ex-landlords. In his order the A.D.C. (Rev) mentions that the first set of dakhilas showing settlement of 0.83 acres at a rental of Tk.1.06 by the ex-landlord appears to be genuine, but the second set of dakhilas showing settlement of 20.14 acres at a rental of Tk.14/- appears to be forged and produced recently. On examination the A.D.C. (Rev) found that S.A. Khatian No. 11 in respect of 0.83 acre of land was rightly recorded in favour of the opposite party but subsequently through manipulation 20.14 acres of land of different plots were brought into that khatian by increasing the rent to Tk. 15/-. On examination by the A.D.C (Rev). Registrar-II showed signs of manipulation by overwriting. The P.R.R. and Tahasil the copy of S.A. Khatian were examined and it was found that nine plots of khas land were included in Khatian No. 11 with different ink. It was further noted that though the opposite party (present plaintiff) paid rent for the khatian at the rate of Tk. 1.06 up to 1369 B.S. yet after this manipulation rent was again realised from him for the same holding from 1367 B.S. to 1370 B.S. On examination of the Office copy of the S.A. khatian of the C.O. (Rev) it was found that vanishing ink was used to erase those plots from the khas khatian and that handwriting of khatian No. 11 (disputed khatian) was entirely different from the handwriting of khatian Nos. 10 and 12. The A.D.C. (Rev) found Khatian No. 11 in the name of the opposite party (present plaintiff) which contains 0.83 acre at a rental of 11.1.06 but subsequently through fraud khas land measuring 20.14 acres of 9 plots were brought in Khatian No. 11 and accordingly plot Nos. 554, 694. 682. 500, 501, 474, 473, 472 and 554 fraudulently entered into khatian No. 11 were restored to Khatian No. 3 maintaining 0.83 acre of land in the name of the plaintiff in khatian No. 11 under rule 23 (4) the State Acquisition Rule. Under rule 23(4) the Revenue Officer is empowered to direct excision of fraudulent entry from the record of rights after final publication there of after consulting the previous settlement records, preliminary rent-rolls, draft record-of-rights. tahasil copies of records and Register-II.
